## What and why

## Checklist (Definition of Done — see CLAUDE.md)
- [ ] Tests added/updated; authorization tested with another user's object
- [ ] Migration reviewed and backward compatible (expand → contract)
- [ ] Router included, models imported, tasks registered
- [ ] Events written through the outbox; consumers idempotent
- [ ] OpenAPI updated and `make types` run
- [ ] Works at 360 / 768 / 1280 px; accessibility checked
- [ ] Logs with request_id; metrics/alerts where needed
- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` updated; ADR written if an architecture choice was made
